purpose: Teach: バリー/メアリー/ラッセル/ジェリー/エド/エドワード/ブラッド/アニー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「バリーの新譜が良い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying Barry's new album is really good.
lines.style: Warm and gently conversational. Soft opening, as if sharing something small and sweet. Unhurried pace. The tone of someone passing along a small piece of news to include him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとメアリー・ポピンズの絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read the Mary Poppins picture book together!
lines.style: Bright and earnest, eyes lighting up on the memory. Quick tempo, eager to share. The 'together' lands with gentle pride. No performance—just genuine delight at being included.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラッセル哲学の入門書を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been reading an introduction to Russell's philosophy.
lines.style: Reflective and attentive, as if noticing something about his father. Steady, measured pace. A small smile in the voice—not surprised, but pleased by the observation she's sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとトムとジェリーのアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched Tom and Jerry together!
lines.style: Enthusiastic and genuine, bright without being loud. Quick, natural delivery. The excitement is real and unguarded. A little laugh-warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエド・シーランの曲を流して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been playing Ed Sheeran's music for us.
lines.style: Gentle and inclusive tone. Soft opening, as if inviting him into something shared. Unhurried. There's a quiet pleasure in mentioning the 'us'—he's noticing he's part of this too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエドワード・タルブの絵画展に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to an Edward Thalbeurne art exhibition!
lines.style: Excited and proud, the words tumbling out with genuine enthusiasm. Quick pace on the main idea. The art exhibition lands with particular brightness—something special and grown-up they did together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがブラッド・ピットの映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been watching a Brad Pitt film.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational tone. Soft and observant, like noticing something about his father's interests. Steady pace. A warmth underneath—not remarkable, just another small thing worth mentioning to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアニーのミュージカルDVD観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched the Annie musical on DVD together!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Quick warm pace, words coming easily. A satisfied joy in the 'together'—the inclusion still fresh and real. Smallest trailing happiness at the end.
